meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 它接手 `migrate-v2.sh` 跑完后的收尾:排查失败的迁移步骤、为 owner 授予 owner 角色、迁移 v1 旧记忆、核对容器配置,并帮你判断哪些 v1 自定义代码能搬过去。
howto.when: 当你已在终端跑完 `bash migrate-v2.sh`,或提到 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration” 等说法时,它接管后续步骤。

say.text: 读一下 handoff.json,告诉我哪一步失败了
say.note: 它会汇总每步结果与待办项

say.text: 帮我确认 owner 并授予 owner 权限
say.note: 它查询 users 表并向你确认身份

say.text: 把 v1 的旧记忆迁移到 v2
say.note: 它会调用 /migrate-memory 处理导入的群组

howto.what_en: After `migrate-v2.sh` finishes, it handles the judgment calls: triaging failed steps, granting the owner role, running the legacy memory migration, reconciling container configs, and helping port v1 fork customizations.
howto.when_en: Runs after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes, or when you mention "migrate from v1", "finish migration" or "v1 migration".

say_en.text: Read handoff.json and tell me which step failed
say_en.note: It summarizes per-step results and followups

say_en.text: Confirm the owner and grant the owner role
say_en.note: It queries the users table and asks you to confirm

say_en.text: Migrate the v1 legacy memory into v2
